daily.today_energy: Your mind is buzzing with possibilities today, Gemini. Channel that restless energy into something creative—your intuition is picking up on vibes others are missing. Trust the flow.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or attracting new energy, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Let people in.
daily.career: Your ideas have momentum today. Don't hold back in conversations or brainstorms—your perspective is exactly what's needed. Collaboration over competition will open unexpected doors.
daily.health: Your nervous system appreciates grounding today. Even 10 minutes of stillness or a walk without your phone can recalibrate your whole vibe. Listen to what your body's actually asking for.

weekly.overview: Mercury's direct energy has you buzzing this week, twin. Your communication channels are wide open and people are actually listening. Lean into conversations that matter and don't sleep on the creative ideas flowing through your mind right now.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is your week to be vulnerable in that specific way only Gemini knows how—thoughtful but playful. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy. The vibe shift is real and it's attracting the right kind of attention your way.
weekly.career: Your ideas are currency right now. Whether it's pitching something new or speaking up in meetings, your voice carries weight. Trust that instinct telling you to take initiative. The momentum is there—you just have to ride it without overthinking.
weekly.health: Your nervous system's asking for a moment to breathe. Channel that restless energy into movement you actually enjoy, not just the stuff you think you should do. Whether it's dancing, walking, or even just shaking it out—your body knows what it needs.
